timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I will guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you will hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let us begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: Being left out really hurts.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I keep wondering why I was not included.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: My mind is looking for what is wrong with me.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I feel pushed to the outside.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: I can feel this sting in my body.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: Part of me wants to pretend I do not care.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I am comparing myself to everyone who was there.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that I feel rejected.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This moment is touching something tender.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that is completely okay. Keep breathing, and we will continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can make room for the hurt without becoming it.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I do not know the whole story.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: Being excluded does not define my value.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can stop searching for flaws in myself.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can soften around this feeling.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I am allowed to care and still protect my peace.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can reach for people who make room for me.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: Belonging does not depend on one invitation.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can let this moment become smaller.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am worthy of reciprocal connection.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I do not have to earn my place by shrinking.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can choose relationships that feel welcoming.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can be on my own side today.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can remember that I belong.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I am more than this one social moment.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can let connection find me in other places.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I trust myself to move toward what feels genuine.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I carry my worth with me.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
